verdicts.reason: Both candidates use the same broken layout. All the content is crammed into the left half and the right half is empty dead space. The orange divider is stranded alone in the middle of the right half, away from the headline it is meant to separate, and the legal line is pushed off to the bottom right as tiny, stray text. A is worse because the dark header band stops partway across, at the edge of the text column, so the canvas looks half-finished. B keeps the full-width header, so at least the brand bar survives the resize.
